events.note: Query: COMMAND 199 and 999 over 2026-01-17 19:45-19:55. Mercury-Pluto enters the 8 degree conjunction orb: Horizons puts Pluto minus Mercury at 8.0005 at 19:49 UT and 7.9994 at 19:50 UT on 2026-01-17.

Query: COMMAND 10, 199, 299, 499, '4;' and 999 over 2026-01-17 19:49-19:51. Closes when its last leg, Mercury-Pluto, enters orb. Horizons at 2026-01-17 19:50 UT: Mercury 295.244, Mars 295.674, Sun 297.712, Venus 300.373, Vesta 303.136, Pluto 303.244, a 7.999 degree spread, so all 15 pairs are within the 8 degree conjunction orb. Its other legs formed before the window. The literal 'undefined' is the missing stellium symbol, which #1362 fixes; update this summary when it lands. The 4-body Mars, Mercury, Sun, Venus stellium already in effect at the window start is deferred to #1363: Vesta is already conjunct with Venus, the Sun and Pluto, and Pluto with Venus, but neither is conjunct with Mars or Mercury yet, so today's rule rejects the whole conjunction component as not a clique.
